arxiv-2202-02751.title: Tubes Among Us: Analog Attack on Automatic Speaker Identification
arxiv-2202-02751.creator: Shimaa Ahmed, Yash Wani, Ali Shahin Shamsabadi, Mohammad Yaghini, Ilia Shumailov, Nicolas Papernot, Kassem Fawaz
arxiv-2202-02751.description: Abstract Recent years have seen a surge in the popularity of acoustics-enabled personal devices powered by machine learning. Yet, machine learning has proven to be vulnerable to adversarial examples. A large number of modern systems protect themselves against such attacks by targeting artificiality, i.e. , they deploy mechanisms to detect the lack of human involvement in generating the adversarial examples.

arxiv-2312-09613.title: Rethinking Causal Relationships Learning in Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2312-09613.creator: Hang Gao, Chengyu Yao, Jiangmeng Li, Lingyu Si, Yifan Jin, Fengge Wu, Changwen Zheng, Huaping Liu
arxiv-2312-09613.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hang Gao, Chengyu Yao, Jiangmeng Li, Lingyu Si, Yifan Jin, Fengge Wu, Changwen Zheng, Huaping Liu. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) demonstrate their significance by effectively modeling complex interrelationships within graph-structured data. To enhance the credibility and robustness of GNNs, it becomes exceptionally crucial to bolster their ability to capture causal relationships. However, despite recent advancements that have indeed strengthened GNNs from a causal learning perspective, conducting an in-depth analysis specifically targeting the causal modeling prowess of GNNs remains an unresolved issue.

arxiv-2401-10146.title: Approximation by perfect complexes detects Rouquier dimension
arxiv-2401-10146.creator: Pat Lank, Noah Olander
arxiv-2401-10146.description: Abstract . This work explores bounds on the Rouquier dimension in the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves on Noetherian schemes. By utilizing approximations, we exhibit that Rouquier dimension is inherently characterized by the number of cones required to build all perfect complexes. We use this to prove sharper bounds on Rouquier dimension of singular schemes.

arxiv-2502-15309.title: DynamicGSG: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Scene Graphs for Environment Adaptation
arxiv-2502-15309.creator: Luzhou Ge, Xiangyu Zhu, Zhuo Yang, Xuesong Li
arxiv-2502-15309.description: Abstract In real-world scenarios, environment changes caused by human or agent activities make it extremely challenging for robots to perform various long-term tasks. Recent works typically struggle to effectively understand and adapt to dynamic environments due to the inability to update their environment representations in memory according to environment changes and lack of fine-grained reconstruction of the environments.

arxiv-2510-23569.title: EgoThinker: Unveiling Egocentric Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal CoT
arxiv-2510-23569.creator: Baoqi Pei, Yifei Huang, Jilan Xu, Yuping He, Guo Chen, Fei Wu, Yu Qiao, Jiangmiao Pang
arxiv-2510-23569.description: Abstract Egocentric video reasoning centers on an unobservable agent behind the camera who dynamically shapes the environment, requiring inference of hidden intentions and recognition of fine-grained interactions. This core challenge limits current multimodal large language models (MLLMs), which excel at visible event reasoning but lack embodied, first-person understanding.

pmc-10654912.title: Twice-Weekly Outpatient Rehabilitation Intervention for Young Children With Spinal Muscular Atrophy Treated With Genetic-Based Therapies: Protocol for a Feasibility Study
pmc-10654912.creator: Christina Ippolito, Lathushikka Canthiya, Amanda Floreani, Kathleen Luckhart, Andrea Hoffman, Laura McAdam, Amaryllis Mavragani, Rocío Martín Valero, Sathish Thirunavukkarasu
pmc-10654912.description: BackgroundSpinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is a progressive neuromuscular disorder that causes muscle weakness and is the leading genetic cause of infant mortality worldwide. While no definitive cure exists, the approval of 3 genetic-based therapies in Canada since 2018 has led to significant improvements in muscle function for children with SMA.

pmc-10656680.title: Factors underlying a disproportionate increase in hospital admissions for adrenal insufficiency in women aged 20-29 years
pmc-10656680.creator: Rosemary Louise Rushworth, Henrik Falhammar, David J. Torpy
pmc-10656680.description: Since the year 2000, admissions for adrenal insufficiency (AI) and adrenal crises (AC) have shown a particular increase in young adult females. We examined data on acute non-surgical hospitalisations for AI/AC from New South Wales, Australia, to determine relevant factors that may have contributed to this increase.

pmc-10670644.title: Preparation and Optimization of Bovine Serum Albumin Nanoparticles as a Promising Gelling System for Enhanced Nasal Drug Administration
pmc-10670644.creator: Sandra Aulia Mardikasari, Gábor Katona, Bence Sipos, Rita Ambrus, Ildikó Csóka, Jilong Wang
pmc-10670644.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Bovine serum albumin (BSA) has been used extensively as a suitable carrier system for alternative drug delivery routes, such as nasal administration. However, the optimization of BSA nanoparticles with respect to their nasal applicability has not been widely studied. The present study focuses on the characterization of BSA nanoparticles prepared using the desolvation method, followed by a gelation process to facilitate intranasal drug delivery.

pmc-11666879.title: A Scoping Review of Arthropod‐Borne Flavivirus Infections in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients
pmc-11666879.creator: Seohyeon Im, Fadie Altuame, Isabel H Gonzalez‐Bocco, Cilomar Martins de Oliveira Filho, Andrea Goldstein Shipper, Maricar Malinis, Carlo Foppiano Palacios
pmc-11666879.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Arthropod‐borne flaviviruses (ABFs), transmitted by mosquitoes or ticks, are increasing due to climate change and globalization. This scoping review examines the epidemiology, clinical characteristics, diagnostics, treatment, and outcomes of ABF infection in solid organ transplant recipients (SOTRs).

pmc-13403052.creator: Marcella Prete, Nicola Susca, Elvira Favoino, Federico Perosa, Daniele Tragni, Luca Navarini, Irene Genovali, Piero Ruscitti, Paola Cipriani, Pasquale Pignataro, Anna Cirulli, Antonio Mazzocca, Patrizia Leone, Vito Racanelli

pmc-13536837.title: Clinical outcomes and molecular features of CEBPA-mutated MPAL: a multi-center case series
pmc-13536837.creator: Yirong Wu, Weijie Luo, Na An, Xiaohan Zhang, Jianyun Li, Yixuan Cao, Yunxin Zeng, Peng Ke, Lu Liu, Linlin Yang, Changru Luo, Shiyu Chen, Sitian Yang, Haoyu Peng, Xiaoqing Li, Jingchao Fan, Rujiao Dong, Bingbing Wen, Xin Du, Lixin Wang, Guangyang Weng
pmc-13536837.description: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia (MPAL) is rare and aggressive, with no standard therapy. CEBPA mutations define favorable-risk AML, but their significance in MPAL is unknown. We reviewed eight CEBPA-mutated MPAL patients from five Chinese centers. Four received allo-HSCT in first complete remission and all remained alive and relapse-free (median follow-up of 24.0 months).

pmc-13624123.title: ART adherence care strategies among adolescents living with HIV in Ghana's Ashanti Region: a qualitative study
pmc-13624123.creator: Doris Hagan, Victor Luckboy Dzramado, Cynthia Yaba Kumah, Charles Domfeh, Joana Edem Koto, Samuel Antwi, Thomas Hormenu
pmc-13624123.description: Adolescents living with HIV (ALHIV) in sub-Saharan Africa carry a disproportionate share of the regional epidemic and consistently record poorer adherence to antiretroviral therapy (ART) than adults. While the statistical correlates of non-adherence are well documented, the everyday strategies adolescents devise to keep themselves on treatment remain comparatively understudied in Ghana.
